preview.title: NVIDIA (@nvidia)
preview.description:
With @GoogleDeepMind, @emblebi, and research partners, we’re making AI-predicted protein complex structures for 2,800+ viruses openly available.
This gives scientists a head start in preparing for potential outbreaks.
